name: Cable Reverse-Grip Preacher Curl
steps: Sit at a preacher bench facing a low pulley and grip its bar palms down with your upper arms supported.
Bend both elbows to curl the bar toward your shoulders.
Guide it down until your arms are nearly straight.
tips: Keep your wrists straight and your shoulders relaxed.
Keep your upper arms flat on the pad and lower under control without locking your elbows.
